The sons of the prophets said to Elisha, “See now, the place where we live and meet with you is too small for us.

translations.web: The children of your bereavement will say in your ears, ‘This place is too small for me. Give me a place to live in.’
translations.bsb: Yet the children of your bereavement will say in your hearing, ‘This place is too small for us; make room for us to live here.’
translations.kjv: The children which thou shalt have, after thou hast lost the other, shall say again in thine ears, The place is too strait for me: give place to me that I may dwell.
translations.asv: The children of thy bereavement shall yet say in thine ears, The place is too strait for me; give place to me that I may dwell.
